data.one_liner: A Flutter plugin for PhonePe Payment SDK to integrate payments.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter apps to initialize the PhonePe payment gateway, start transactions, and handle payment results for Android and iOS platforms.
use_when: You need to integrate PhonePe payment gateway in your Flutter application
You are targeting Android and iOS platforms for PhonePe transactions
avoid_when: You are using payment gateways other than PhonePe
You need in-app purchases through App Store or Google Play billing
strengths: Direct integration with PhonePe payment gateway
weaknesses: Limited documentation inside the README requiring external contact for deep integration
Platform-specific setup required for Android and iOS
data.setup_notes: Requires adding dependency via pub, initializing the SDK with environment values, merchant ID, and flow ID, and configuring native project requirements as requested by PhonePe.

alternatives.name: flutter_stripe
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want to use Stripe as your payment gateway instead of PhonePe.

alternatives.name: adyen_checkout
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want to use Adyen for payment processing instead of PhonePe.

alternatives.name: pay
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want to integrate Google Pay and Apple Pay instead of a specific gateway like PhonePe.
